dolphin hunting
services.desc: How do we guarantee sightings on our Hilton Head dolphin tours? Our Guaranteed Dolphin Encounters start with our team of knowledgeable captains. These pros spend every day on the water, so they know exactly where our flippered friends like to hang out. Furthermore, we are lucky to have a resident population of about 200-400 Near Coastal Bottlenose dolphins-close relatives of the Atlantic Bottlenose-who call these waterways home year-round. Because Hilton Head has massive tides, there is a constant flow of water that keeps an abundance of food moving.
